items.headline: Flood Warning issued May 17 at 8:12PM AKDT until May 18 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by high water and heavy ice runs continues
to be possible.

* WHERE...Galena and Koyukuk.

* WHEN...Until 1000 PM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...High water may result in flooding of rivers, creeks,
streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 800 PM AKDT, public reports continued minor flooding in
the region. High water and heavy ice runs along the Yukon
River and Koyukuk River will result in minor flooding impacts
in Galena and Koyuku
items.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services, law
enforcement, or to the National Weather Service when you can do so
safely.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 17 at 8:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Russian Mission, Marshall, Pilot Station, and St. Mary's.

The breakup front along the Yukon River has moved downstream of
Grayling. High water and heavy ice runs along the Lower Yukon River
may result in minor flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other
low-lying and flood-prone locations.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued May 17 at 12:38PM AKDT until May 18 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Mixed precipitation expected. Total snow accumulations up
to one inch and ice accumulations up to 0.01 inches.

* WHERE...Bering Strait Coast, Diomede, and St Lawrence Island.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 10 AM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Travel may be impacted.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Ice accumulations will be most likely on
elevated surfaces such as stairs. Surfaces may be slick.
items.areas: Shishmaref; Bering Strait Coast; St Lawrence Island
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.
